title: Evidence Saturation Report
description: DISCOVER-stage advisory artifact. Output of evidence-saturation-judge: a deterministic measurement of whether a literature/evidence search has SATURATED (diminishing new results across rounds) or still needs more queries. Domain-agnostic. Computed by the deterministic tools/saturation_meter.py from a per-round search history; the judge never sets the verdict by hand. This informs (does NOT decide) the DISCOVER gate: lit-scout's self-asserted saturation_reached boolean is here replaced by a measured, multi-round new-result-rate. A SCORE/RATE never silently terminates a search — INSUFFICIENT_DATA is emitted when there are too few rounds to judge.

report_id.description: Short unique identifier for this saturation report, e.g. SAT-001. Non-blank.

rounds.description: Per-round search history, in chronological order (round 0 first). Each round records the queries run and how many unique sources it surfaced. An empty array is allowed (yields INSUFFICIENT_DATA).

queries_run.description: Number of distinct queries issued in this round.

new_unique_sources.description: Count of sources first seen in this round (not present in any earlier round). Anti-double-count: this is the dedup'd delta, not raw hits.

cumulative_unique_sources.description: Running total of distinct unique sources seen through (and including) this round. Monotonically non-decreasing across rounds.

new_result_rate_last_round.description: Fraction of the last round's surfaced sources that were NEW (new_unique / total_seen_this_round-basis). 0.0 means the last round surfaced nothing new (fully saturated signal); near 1.0 means the search is still finding fresh material.

duplicate_rate.description: Cumulative fraction of surfaced results that were duplicates of already-seen sources, across the whole history = 1 - (cumulative_unique / total_surfaced). 0.0 = no overlap yet; high = the search is heavily re-treading known ground.

coverage_dimensions.description: Which angles / facets the search covered (e.g. method, dataset, application-domain, baseline, ablation). Carried for the gate's qualitative read; the meter does not require any particular dimension. Each entry must be non-blank.

saturation_score.description: A [0,1] saturation index where 1.0 = fully saturated (no new results) and 0.0 = wide open. Derived from the last round's new-result rate (saturation_score = 1 - new_result_rate_last_round). A score is advisory and never on its own cuts a search.

verdict.description: SATURATED = new-result rate stayed below the documented threshold over the last N rounds (search may stop). NOT_SATURATED = still finding fresh material (widen / keep searching). INSUFFICIENT_DATA = fewer than the minimum number of rounds to judge (never a silent cut).

rationale.description: Optional one-line human-readable explanation of the verdict (the meter fills a default; the judge may enrich).
